blocks.text: LUCENA CITY – Police arrested four men in Tanay, Rizal, early Tuesday after intercepting a closed van carrying 79 pieces of lumber valued at P23,000. Rizal police said personnel of the Rizal Provincial Mobile Force Company flagged down the van in Barangay Cuyambay at around 3:45 a.m. while conducting “Oplan Sita,” a routine anti-criminality operation.
